## History

Magog was packed in a box under the spare-room bed alongside [Gog](../character/gog.md) before Miss [Patty](../character/patty.md) sent the key to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). Magog eventually came to preside over the hearth of the little house, where Captain Jim took a great fancy to him during a visit from [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). He maintained the same dignity and aplomb at the hearth as he had previously shown at Patty's Place.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P5](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P2](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P7](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0007), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P13](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0013), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P19](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0019), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P23](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0023)_
